item.text: *Galeola falconeri* is a large, leafless orchid found from the central Himalayas to Thailand. It lacks chlorophyll, has highly branched stems supported by shrubs, and produces reddish inflorescences with small, externally hairy flowers. It lives in close symbiosis with mycorrhizal fungi and is unsuitable for home cultivation. [Source: s1:p1]
